gift-wrap-details.What is included: Recyclable paper, a paper ribbon and a plain message card. Sample wrapping costs £3 per eligible item.
gift-wrap-details.Eligible items: Available for the sample tray and planter; oversized items are excluded.
gift-wrap-details.Message and ordering: A message can contain up to 120 characters. This review page does not accept orders or add wrapping.

dispatch-schedule.Dispatch days: The fictional shop packs orders Monday to Thursday. Orders placed before noon normally enter the next packing session.
dispatch-schedule.Delivery is separate: Carrier transit starts after dispatch. Dispatch is not a guaranteed arrival date.
dispatch-schedule.Exceptions: Made-to-order items have their own estimate; bank holidays may change the schedule.

showroom-information.Plan a visit: Fictional showroom: 12 Sample Lane, Exampletown. Open Tuesday to Saturday, 10am to 4pm.
showroom-information.Access: The sample entrance is level; contact the shop to discuss individual access requirements.
showroom-information.On display: The sample ceramic planter and wooden tray can be viewed. Call before travelling to check current availability.

holiday-service-hours.Illustrative closure: This fictional team is closed 24–26 December and reopens on 27 December. Replace these dates before any real use.
holiday-service-hours.Replies: Requests received during the closure are reviewed after reopening. No response time is guaranteed.
holiday-service-hours.Existing appointments: Contact the team in advance if an already agreed appointment needs discussion.

remote-consultation-details.Format: An illustrative 20-minute video conversation to discuss the project and decide whether a longer consultation would help.
remote-consultation-details.Prepare: Bring a short brief, photographs and your main questions. Test your audio connection first.
remote-consultation-details.Next step: The business must confirm scope, any fee and a time with you. This information page creates no appointment.

contributor-guidelines.Topic fit: Our fictional publication considers practical essays on making, design and everyday learning. Read recent issues before pitching.
contributor-guidelines.Pitch format: Prepare a 150-word outline, the reader question it answers and a short author introduction. Do not send a full draft until requested.
contributor-guidelines.Editorial process: An editor reviews fit before commissioning. Acceptance, payment and rights must be agreed separately; this demo accepts no pitches.

venue-hire-checklist: Offer a venue hire planning checklist

venue-hire-checklist.List your practical needs: Write the purpose, approximate guest count, seating style and equipment needs. Ask the venue to confirm its usable capacity for that layout.
venue-hire-checklist.Check access and facilities: Ask about step-free routes, toilets, parking, unloading and available furniture. Verify details before promising an arrangement to guests.
venue-hire-checklist.Prepare timing questions: Include setup, the event and pack-down in the requested hours. Ask about noise limits, cleaning, deposits and cancellation terms before agreeing a booking.

contributor-pitch-checklist.Identify the reader question: Write one sentence stating the reader problem and why it matters to this publication. Check recent coverage before pitching.
contributor-pitch-checklist.Outline the evidence: List the examples, primary sources or reporting you can use. Distinguish what you already know from what still needs research.
contributor-pitch-checklist.Explain your approach: Prepare a short outline, likely length, proposed format and a short author introduction. Ask about commissioning terms before writing a full draft.
